title: Canada hotel fire with Earl Hines and bassist Jonesy
summary: Bigard tells how Frenchy's condemned hotel burned and the bassist broke his back without compensation.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: And we had another guy was in the band and we was up in Canada and this Frenchy is -- instead of going into a good hotel, he went in a ricky-tick hotel that was condemned and luckily I didn't stay there and two or three others didn't

stay but Earl Hines and guy -- bass player from Texas, Jonesy, we used to call him-- Jones, and they stayed in this hotel someone -- one morning we get up and saw the smoke coming like from the place so he said, oh, there must be a fire at the place where we're working, sure enough it was. So we put on some clothes and we went on down there --Earl Hines in standing out in the street, a cigar in his mouth and a hat on his head, half naked. Poor Jonesy, he couldn't get out -- they had -- the exit doors were nailed, and he got out on the ledge on the window -- out the window on a ledge onthe second floor and he fell off and broke his back. You know he didn't get a dime. Not a dime from the office. Joe Glaser said, well I'll get my lawyer and we'll take care of it. And you'll be all right, don't worry. That's the last he heard of it.
That, Joe's lawyer and the other lawyer made a settlement, I guess, and this poor guy he didn't get a dime out of the whole bit.
What was his whole name, Jonesy?
Oh, golly I don't remember. He was from Texas, too. Real nice man. German (unintelligible).
